subject: IAM evidence: SSO/SAML samples, SCIM deltas, and ownership timeline
messages:
From: Anna Miles <anna@clearlake.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T08:12:00Z
Subject: IAM evidence request for SOC 2 intake

Hi Laura,

We're starting our SOC 2 intake for ClearLake and need a focused IAM/artifact bundle for the production tenant. Specifically we need: 
- SSO/SAML assertion samples (a few successful assertions) showing common attributes (eduPersonPrincipalName / email / groups)
- SCIM delta / full snapshot covering the last 30 days (role membership + service account mappings)
- Role owner mapping and evidence of least-privilege reviews for admin roles
- Service account inventory and proof of rotation / owner custody for any long-lived keys

Can you confirm scope and whether you can provide redacted artifacts (PII removed) or whether you prefer us to accept redaction instructions from your team? Also please confirm estimated delivery date — our deadline for the intake bundle is 2028-06-07.

Thanks,
Anna Miles
Senior InfoSec Analyst
ClearLake Analytics

--
Attachment: intake_checklist_v2.pdf (reference only)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Anna Miles <anna@clearlake.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request for SOC 2 intake

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. Confirming scope: production tenant only (not staging), and we'll provide redacted artifacts following the standard SOC-friendly redaction guidance (replace email local-parts with hashes, keep role names and owner usernames).

Planned deliverables:
- 3 SAML assertion samples (success + initial login flow) in XML: saml_assertion_sample.xml
- SCIM snapshot + delta covering 2028-05-01 to 2028-05-31: scim_delta_prod_snapshot.csv (we'll redact user emails)
- Role-to-owner matrix (CSV): role_owner_map_202805.csv with contact owner and last attestation timestamp
- Service account inventory (redacted): service_account_inventory_redacted.csv and a short rotation log excerpt showing key rotation dates

We will also include a short README describing our redaction approach and the query used to extract SCIM deltas. Target delivery: 2028-06-03 EOD PT. If that works for you we'll upload to a shared Drive folder and send a secure link.

Two quick items for your intake:
1) Please confirm you only need role-level membership, not full attribute dumps for users (we'll keep attribute output minimal).
2) If you need assertion traces that include relay-state or NameID formats other than email, let us know now so we include the additional sample.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: README-redaction.md (text), redaction_rules.txt (text)

From: Anna Miles <anna@clearlake.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T11:07:00Z
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request for SOC 2 intake

Laura — thanks, that scope and timeline work. A couple clarifications:
- We only need role-level membership (confirmed).
- Please include one SAML assertion sample that shows group membership in the attributes (we use group->role mapping in our evaluation).
- Also include any JIT/ephemeral admin rotation logs you have for privileged scopes (we typically ask for a sample week of rotations).

We created an intake ticket (HBSP-987654) on our side — I'll reference that with any follow-ups. Drive link is preferred for large CSVs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Anna

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Anna Miles <anna@clearlake.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-03T15:40:00Z
Subject: Delivery: IAM artifacts (production tenant) — ClearLake HBSP-987654

Hi Anna — attaching the bundle for the production tenant per HBSP-987654. Files uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cClearlakeEvidence

What we included (brief):
- saml_assertion_sample.xml (3 examples; one includes groups attribute)
- scim_delta_prod_snapshot.csv (30-day delta, emails hashed, uid preserved)
- role_owner_map_202805.csv (role, owner_email_hashed, last_attested_at)
- service_account_inventory_redacted.csv (service account id, owner, last_key_rotation_date)
- README-redaction.md (details of redaction regex and extraction queries)

Notes about redaction and custody:
- We hashed email local-parts with SHA256 (first 8 chars shown). Full contact details are available under NDA if needed.
- Service account rotation excerpts show rotation events and ticket references (log excerpt attached as service_account_rotation_excerpt.txt).
- SAML assertion samples are anonymized except for role/group claims and NameID format.

If you need the full, non-redacted artifacts for an in-person review under NDA, we can arrange a secure transfer. Otherwise the uploaded bundle should be sufficient for SOC 2 artifact review.

Let us know if anything is missing and we'll prioritize follow-up.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments included: saml_assertion_sample.xml, scim_delta_prod_snapshot.csv, role_owner_map_202805.csv, service_account_inventory_redacted.csv, README-redaction.md, service_account_rotation_excerpt.txt
